_about: Benjamin Hall Kennedy (1804-1889), headmaster of Shrewsbury and Regius Professor of Greek at Cambridge, raw IA OCR: The Birds of Aristophanes translated into English verse (Macmillan, 1874); The Theaetetus of Plato with translation and notes (Cambridge University Press, 1881); Virgil, Bucolica, Georgica, Aeneis, with a commentary and appendices, third edition (Longmans, 1881); Studia Sophoclea, part I, a critical examination of Lewis Campbell's Sophocles (Deighton, Bell, 1874); The Public School Latin Grammar, fifth edition (Longmans, 1879). His Agamemnon (1882) is on the aeschylus shelf and his Oedipus Tyrannus (1885) on the sophocles shelf. Not taken: his sermons and English Psalter (theology, for the divines lanes). Latin-dense volumes kept per Adam's 2026-10-23 ruling. Classical scholarship (lane B, round dv). No uids minted.
